description: Baseline eval prompts. should_trigger entries must invoke the skill; should_not_trigger entries must not. Compatible with skill-creator's run_loop.py.

should_trigger.prompt: Generate the actual SVG markup for a new element icon — I need the vector file, not a prose description.
Redesign the icon for the cloud_storage element — I want three SVG variants to compare, not changes to the YAML.
Show me three SVG options for an icon representing differential privacy in DTPR style.
The accept_deny icon doesn't read at sign scale — iterate on the symbol until it works at 24×24.
Draft an SVG symbol for an element about model card disclosure — it should sit in the rights category.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Refactor this TypeScript function to return a Result type instead of throwing.
Write a SQL query that returns the top 10 customers by revenue in the last quarter.
My GitHub Actions workflow is failing on the lint step. Help me debug it.
DTPR doesn't say anything about LLM hallucination disclosure. Propose changes to cover that.
Propose an element for appeal-after-automated-decision — a person contests an algorithmic denial and a human adjudicator resolves it within a stated window.
Walk me through the accountable category for a library self-checkout kiosk — does the schema capture multi-party responsibility?
Grade the accept_deny element for public comprehension — I just want a readability audit, not a proposal.
